verses.text: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on a mountain and sat down. His followers came to him,
and he began to teach them. He said:
"Blessed are those who know they need God, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.
Blessed are those who are sad, because God will comfort them.
Blessed are those who are humble, because the earth will belong to them.
Blessed are those who are hungry and thirsty to do what is right, because God will fill them.
Blessed are those who show mercy to others, because God will show mercy to them.
Blessed are those whose hearts are pure, because they will see God.
Blessed are those who make peace, because they will be called God's children.
Blessed are those who are treated badly for doing what is right, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.
"You are blessed when people insult you, treat you badly and tell all kinds of evil lies about you because you follow me.
Be happy and full of joy, because you have a great reward waiting in heaven. People treated the prophets who lived before you in the same way.
"You are the salt of the earth. But if salt loses its taste, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and walked on.
"You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.
People do not light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead, they put it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
In the same way, let your light shine in front of other people. Then they will see the good things you do and praise your Father in heaven.
"Do not think that I have come to get rid of the Law or the words of the prophets. I have not come to get rid of them, but to make them come true.
I tell you for certain, until heaven and earth disappear, not even the smallest letter or the smallest mark will disappear from the Law, until everything has happened.

So whoever breaks even one of the least of these commands, and teaches others to do the same, will be called the least in the kingdom of heaven. But whoever obeys these commands and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
I tell you, unless you do what is right better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the law, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
"You have heard that people were told long ago, 'Do not murder. Anyone who murders will be judged.'

But I tell you that anyone who is angry with their brother or sister without a good reason will be judged. Anyone who calls someone 'You idiot!' will have to answer to the court. And anyone who says 'You fool!' will be in danger of the fire of hell.
"So if you are bringing your gift to the altar, and there you remember that someone has something against you,
leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and make peace with that person. Then come back and offer your gift.

If someone is taking you to court, make friends with them quickly, while you are still on the way. If you do not, they may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the guard, and you may be thrown into prison.
I tell you for certain, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.
"You have heard that it was said, 'Do not commit adultery.'
But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman and wants her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
If your right eye makes you sin, pull it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
And if your right hand makes you sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to go into hell.
"It was also said, 'Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a written notice of divorce.'
But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except because she has been unfaithful, makes her a victim of adultery. And anyone who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
"Again, you have heard that people were told long ago, 'Do not break your promises, but keep the promises you have made to the Lord.'
But I tell you, do not make promises by swearing at all. Do not swear by heaven, because it is God's throne.
Do not swear by the earth, because it is where he rests his feet. Do not swear by Jerusalem, because it is the city of the great King.
And do not swear by your head, because you cannot make even one hair white or black.
Just let your 'Yes' mean 'Yes', and your 'No' mean 'No'. Anything more than this comes from the evil one.
"You have heard that it was said, 'An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.'
But I tell you, do not fight back against an evil person. If someone slaps you on the right cheek, turn the other cheek to them as well.
If someone takes you to court to get your shirt, let them have your coat as well.
If someone forces you to carry their things for one mile, go two miles with them.
Give to anyone who asks you, and do not turn away anyone who wants to borrow from you.
"You have heard that it was said, 'Love your neighbour and hate your enemy.'
But I tell you, love your enemies. Bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who hurt you and treat you badly.
Then you will be children of your Father in heaven. He makes his sun rise on bad people and good people, and he sends rain on those who do right and those who do wrong.
If you love only those who love you, what reward will you get? Even the tax collectors do that.
And if you greet only your friends, what are you doing more than others? Even people who do not know God do that.
So be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
